title: AI Hack That Doubled My Productivity
full_monologue: **This AI hack changed everything.** I used to waste hours on repetitive tasks, but now I automate them all. The tool learns my workflow and handles the busywork. I’ve reclaimed hours a day—think about what you could do with that time. It’s not just faster, it’s smarter. You’ll wonder how you ever worked without it. What’s your biggest time-waster?
